acceptanceCriteria: An operator command removes only unreferenced terminal stage worktrees, with a test.
A reassign no longer orphans the prior stage worktree, or the leftover is reported and cleanable.
body: Observed on branch claude/v1-0475-multi-repo (head e62e5bdb, base origin/main d524530f), Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Go 1.27.1, darwin/arm64, by the issue 354 lane. Found by source reading during the issue 354 lane. (1) CleanupWorktrees exists in the store but no CLI command calls it, so supervised stage worktrees are never removed by the product. (2) A reassign in OpenWorkflow leaves the previous stage worktrees behind. Expected: an operator-invoked cleanup path for terminal attempts and reassigned stages that preserves any worktree still referenced by a live attempt or candidate.
title: Stage worktrees leak: CleanupWorktrees has no CLI caller and an OpenWorkflow reassign leaves the previous stage worktrees
